mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp, or Rank IC remains below 0.01 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases above 3.5% and unemployment rate rises above 4.0% signal severe monetary tightening with labor market stress, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >50% of instances meeting both triggers, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, residential construction permits (HOUST) exceeding 1200 thousand units signal robust consumer spending that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of late-cycle expansion instances with HOUST >1200, or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 100 thousand signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >55% of instances with PAYEMS increase >100k, or Rank IC <0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production (INDPRO) decline below 105.0 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >45% of INDPRO <105.0 instances, or Rank IC <0.01 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous residential construction permits (HOUST) below 1150 thousand units and industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 signal broad economic slowdown that reduces earnings expectations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances meeting both triggers, or Rank IC <0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a sustained annual CPIAUCSL increase above 3.5% signals persistent inflation that forces prolonged high interest rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of monetary tightening instances with CPIAUCSL >3.5% annually, or Rank IC <0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.
